peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 45.6% above its local comparables; 129 of 130 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (56.9): 3.3 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 219 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 9). Context, not scored: resales in 41.7% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $2,531,500 ($2,529 psf, 1,001–1,033 sq ft; 6 resales, Aug 2024–Jul 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,737 psf (range $1,545–2,535); 45.6% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $793,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: The first resale wave ended before the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity. First resale wave from Apr 2023 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date); 4 earlier resales do not start the wave.

wave.basisLabel: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Lavender MRT about 450 m, Kallang MRT about 710 m; closer than 396 of 662 similar developments (the same as 11). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 3 within 2 km; nearest Bendemeer Primary School about 1,650 m; more than 0 of 662 similar developments (the same as 125). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 7 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 420 m), more than 243 of 662 similar developments (the same as 37); nearest hawker centre North Bridge Road Market about 390 m; nearest park Kallang Riverside Park about 100 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 7 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Aurea, 39 new sales, about 470 m; Midtown Modern, 1 new sales, about 1,470 m; Midtown Bay, 4 new sales, about 1,610 m; Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 1,700 m; The Arcady at Boon Keng, 32 new sales, about 1,830 m; Zyanya, 2 new sales, about 1,950 m; Duet @ Emily, 3 new sales, about 1,990 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 130 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 82 new sales and 478 resales (560 purchases); new sales were 14.6% of these purchases. Subsales (67) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Kallang Close GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 610 m; Dorset Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,770 m; Tanjong Rhu Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,820 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 478 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 102 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 478 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 508 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−5.9%). Planning-area private resales −11.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
